articles.title: Injuries and transactions | Timmins progressing in rehab
Sabres vs. Stars | How to watch, lineup notes and storylines

away.summary: Utah Mammoth (3-1-0) are on a road trip and will face the Boston Bruins after a 5-3 win over New Jersey Devils. Head coach André Tourigny confirmed no lineup changes from the morning skate, with veterans like Nick Schmaltz (5 goals, 7 points) providing leadership. The team aims to maintain its identity and exploit its strengths against a Bruins squad known for grit, skill, and strong defensive structure.

out.detail: upper body injury, on IR since Sept. 24
lower body injury, on IR since Sept. 26, began rehab skating Oct. 8
sports hernia, out since start of camp, returned to practice Oct. 6 in non-contact jersey, 'probably a couple weeks out'

home.summary: Buffalo Sabres (2-1-0) are seeking a third straight win against the Dallas Stars, having trailed 2-0 before coming back to beat the Wild in overtime. The team leads the NHL in even-strength expected goals share (65.4%) and has a strong 19-0-3 run vs. Western Conference teams. Mattias Samuelsson is in the lineup after missing Wednesday's practice for maintenance, and Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen gets his third start of the season.
